business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail of Dietary Supplements and Nutraceuticals Online

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (unitary national system; corporate law under Ley 32 de 1927 is decisively influenced by U.S. general corporation law, creating a hybrid commercial corporate doctrine)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: U.S. – Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA), in force since 31 October 2012
OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (MAAC), effective for Panama in 2017, enabling AEOI/CRS exchange
Double Taxation Agreements in force (selected): Spain, Mexico, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, France, Netherlands, Portugal, Luxembourg, United Kingdom, Republic of Korea, Turkey and Singapore
ICSID Convention – Panama has been a Contracting State since 1996, granting investors access to international investor-State arbitration

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT law) and implementing resolutions issued by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF); Law 70 of 9 December 2019 (Régimen de Transparencia y Registro de Titulares de Beneficiarios Finales) repealing and replacing Executive Decree 129 of 2018; implementing regulations issued by the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance; applicable GAFILAT/FATF recommendations; Código de Comercio and Ley 32 de 1927 for corporate books and resident agent obligations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport (clear color scan) of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner above the 25% threshold
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-authority / Notary Public of the UBO's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if the UBO's country is a Hague Convention party) OR Consular Legalization before the Panamanian Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Domicile / proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, municipality, or regulated financial institution in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization; notarized English or Spanish translation must accompany non-Spanish documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / Good Standing of the corporate shareholder (if a corporate UBO is in the chain)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Companies Registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Poder General) executed by the incorporators/shareholders in favor of the Panamanian resident agent for the purpose of incorporation and UBO filing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of execution; or a Notario Público in Panama for locally executed powers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization if executed abroad

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI list, Panama's UAF national PEP database and GAFILAT high-risk country list, supported by an external compliance-screening tool; full beneficial-ownership verification and source-of-funds documentation for all UBOs/PEPs; Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), ongoing transaction monitoring, and independent AML officer sign-off are obligatory for the ISIC 4791 high-risk online cross-border nutraceuticals merchant profile before onboarding any high-risk merchant account.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Plataforma de Servicios en Línea (https://www.registropublico.gob.pa) – Solicitud de Búsqueda de Nombre y Certificado de Registro, governed by Ley Orgánica 1 de 1995
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Latin/Spanish script. If a foreign denomination is used, it must be transliterated into Spanish phonetic form for the registry index; the name must include the legal token 'Sociedad Anónima' or the abbreviation 'S.A.' and must not be identical, phonetically identical, or confusingly similar to an existing registered company, partnership, foundation, or trademark recorded in the Public Registry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: BANCO / BANCARIO (prior authorization from the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá)
SEGUROS / REASEGURO / ASEGURADORA (prior authorization from the Superintendencia de Seguros y Reaseguros de Panamá)
BOLSA / VALORES / FONDO DE PENSIONES (prior authorization from the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores)
COOPERATIVA (prior authorization from the Autoridad de Supervisión de Cooperativas)
UNIVERSIDAD / EDUCACIÓN / COLEGIO (prior authorization from the Ministerio de Educación)
SALUD / CLÍNICA / FARMACIA / HOSPITAL (prior authorization from the Ministerio de Salud for regulated-health connotations)
GOBIERNO / NACIONAL / MINISTERIO / MUNICIPAL / AUTORIDAD (reserved for state and official entities; creates a presumption of government affiliation)
CRUZ ROJA / DEFENSORÍA / PNUD / UNIÓN EUROPEA (international or protected institutional designations require prior written consent)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 30 days of issuance, the certificate must be converted into incorporation; if not used within this window, the certificate lapses and the name returns to the available pool. If the name is rejected, the applicant may reissue a corrected search application or file a 'Recurso de Reconsideración' with the Dirección General del Registro Público within 15 business days of notice, invoking Ley 38 de 2000 (Normas de Procedimiento Administrativo); if reconsideration fails, a hierarchical 'Recurso de Apelación' is available before the up-line authority (Ministerio de Gobierno), with further judicial review before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso-Administrativo de la Corte Suprema de Justicia. A new statutory search fee applies for each resubmission.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible. Ley 32 de 1927 requires the company to maintain, at all times, a licensed Panamanian resident agent ('agente residente') with a physical street address in the Republic; the corporate records and statutory books may be kept abroad. A virtual office in Panama may satisfy the agent's outward-facing address but cannot replace the resident agent; for the high-risk cross-border dietary-supplements e-commerce model, acquiring banks and the merchant processor will normally require a demonstrable operational or logistics address in a supported jurisdiction, separate from the registered agent address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 35–45% unannounced-inspection probability within the first 24 months of merchant activity, driven by (a) Registro Público edict and resident-agent record verifications, (b) MINSA sanitary-authority spot checks if product is imported or warehoused in Panama, and (c) card-network/acquiring-bank terminal inspections under High-Risk Merchant Account terms; the pure holding entity without in-territory inventory or logistics faces a materially lower inspection risk of under 10%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the edict of incorporation (Edicto de Constitución) in the Boletín del Registro Público de Panamá

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Fiscal registration – RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) and Aviso de Operación before the Dirección General de Ingresos and municipality of the registered agent

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Panama Companies Act - Ley No. 32 of 26 February 1927, Articles 1 to 72 (Sociedades Anónimas), as amended, together with the Public Registry regulations and Executive Decree No. 1084 of 1927 on registry procedure.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama) - Dirección de Registro de Personas Jurídicas / Sección de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública No. ___ sobre Pacto Social y Estatutos (Public Deed of Articles of Incorporation), presented for inscription through an authenticated testimonio.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required; the deed must state the authorized capital and at least one issued share. No escrow account is mandated by law. For regulatory credibility with the Ministry of Health and acquiring banks, a demonstrated paid-up position of at least USD 10,000 is recommended.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A. The Directors unanimously resolve that: (1) the share subscription of the founding shareholders be accepted and the corresponding share certificates be issued; (2) the registered office and designated resident agent located in Panama be adopted as the company's statutory address, effective immediately; (3) [Name] as President, [Name] as Secretary, and [Name] as Treasurer are appointed officers; (4) the officers are authorized to open bank and merchant processing accounts, execute regulatory filings, and apply for the Ministry of Health and municipal licenses required for the e-commerce of dietary supplements, with full corporate powers; and (5) this resolution be recorded in the corporate minutes book pursuant to Law 32 of 1927, as amended.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Departamento de Registro de Personas Jurídicas (online portal: registropublico.gob.pa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Solicitud de Búsqueda de Nombre for at least two proposed corporate names with the subscriber's sworn statement. Pay the official search fee and obtain the Certificado de Reserva de Nombre, valid for 30 days, coordinating with the licensed registered agent.
required_dossiers: Completed name search application (Solicitud de Búsqueda de Nombre)
Sworn statement of proposed corporate purpose
Valid passport or juridical identity of the initial subscriber(s)
Letter of authorization to the resident registered agent
Payment receipt for name reservation fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for identity or similarity with an existing registered entity, refile with alternative names within 48 hours or present a written opposition/waiver from the prior registrant for the Registry's review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notaría de la República de Panamá) jointly with the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Pacto Social y Estatutos using the reserved name, including standard S.A. clauses covering ISIC 4791 e-commerce objects, share classes, director powers, territorial tax election, and arbitration. All subscribing shareholders must appear before the notary to execute the deed; the notary certifies the signatures and inserts the required fiscal stamps.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or constitutional corporate documents of each shareholder
Certificate of corporate name reservation
Draft Pacto Social y Estatutos in Spanish
Proof of registered agent appointment and registered office address
Notarial stamps and legal fee receipts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or registered agent objects to certain clauses, revise the defective provisions, re-execute the deed before the same notary, or issue a clarifying certification (aclaración) prior to registry submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Sociedad Anónima at the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección de Sociedades / Dirección de Registro de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the original notarized testimonio of the Escritura Pública, the registered agent's cover letter, and proof of payment of official registration and tasa fees. The Registry performs calificación registral; the legal existence of the company takes effect upon inscription. Once approved, the Registry issues the Ficha and a certified copy of the registered deed.
required_dossiers: Original notarized testimonio of the Escritura Pública
Registered agent presentation or cover letter
Receipt of payment of registration and official fees
Affidavit of the designated resident agent accepting the office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues observations (observaciones), cure the identified defects within 10 working days, re-notarize a corrective amendment, or file an administrative appeal (recurso de apelación) within 5 working days before the superior body of the Public Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Identification (RUC) and ITBMS Registration with the Tax Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas - e-DGI portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Formulario de Inscripción y Actualización RUC accompanied by the certified copy of the registered deed and identification documents of the directors and officers. Request the ITBMS (7%) registration for the online sale and delivery of goods and obtain the Certificado de Registro RUC required for municipal licensing and merchant account processing.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered Escritura Pública and Ficha
RUC application form and Spanish authorization letters
Passports and Panamanian cédula copies of directors and officers
Proof of registered address (rental contract or utility bill)
Registered agent acceptance certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI returns queries for incomplete documentation, provide notarized Spanish translations of foreign documents or a corrected power of attorney and respond in writing within 5 working days to prevent suspension of the RUC application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Formalization of Corporate Governance Books and Adoption of the First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company's board of directors and registered office, certified by the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting to approve the share subscription and allotment, ratify the registered office and resident agent, and appoint the officers. Record the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution in the corporate minutes book, issue numbered share certificates, and complete the shareholders' register entries.
required_dossiers: Ficha and certified copy of the registered deed
Share subscription list and subscriber due-diligence files
Executed First Board Resolution minutes
Share certificate stubs and shareholders' register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the meeting record shows quorum or authentication defects, convene an adjourned meeting to ratify the resolution retroactively; if the registered agent refuses certification, correct the notarial seal or reissue the corporate books.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating Authorization and Fire Department Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía del Distrito de Panamá (Aviso de Operación) and Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the physical warehouse and office address under the municipal Aviso de Operación system for ISIC 4791, pay the municipal fees, and submit the Certificado de Aceptación issued by the Fire Department for the storage area. This municipal patent is a prerequisite for Ministry of Health licensing and high-risk merchant facility onboarding.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate and corporate Ficha
Lease or title evidence for warehouse and office premises
Fire Department acceptance certificate
Municipal Aviso de Operación application form
Affidavit of floor area and use of premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality rejects the Aviso for zoning inconsistency, obtain a certificado de uso de suelo and adjust the declared activity; if the fire clearance is rejected, complete the required structural and electrical corrections and resubmit the certificate for municipal endorsement.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) - Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas (DNFD), which administers the sanitary registration and operational licensing of natural products and dietary supplements for domestic and cross-border e-commerce.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Producto Natural and Licencia Sanitaria de Funcionamiento para Distribución y Comercio Electrónico (ISIC 4791).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III - Aviso de Impacto Ambiental (low-impact registration) for the warehouse and logistics operation; a full Estudio de Impacto Ambiental (Category I) is required only if the facility is expanded to pharmaceutical manufacturing or large cold-chain installation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge to municipal sewers must comply with ANAM Resolution No. AG-0211-2003 limits (BOD5 not exceeding 100 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 100 mg/L, pH 6-9). Warehouse VOC and refrigerant management must meet national air quality thresholds with no uncontrolled point-source emissions. Solid and packaging waste must be handled under the integrated waste reporting regime of Law No. 8 of 2018 using registered disposal operators.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá covering detection systems, extinguishers, and evacuation routes; municipal structural load inspection and certificado de uso de suelo from the Alcaldía del Distrito de Panamá; and occupational health and safety registration before the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL), including the workplace risk prevention committee and plan required under Ley 44 de 1994, as amended.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas — official e-services portal: https://dgi.mef.gob.pa and https://pita.mef.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign or local entity, the statutory step is to obtain a Panama RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente). A Panama Sociedad Anónima is first registered with the Public Registry; then the company must submit the RUC registration application on Form DGI-01 via the PITA portal or a licensed tax representative, attaching the notary certified public-registry inscription (Ficha), corporate documents, proof of registered agent and fiscal domicile, and appointee identification. Foreign entities without a Panama subsidiary are also eligible to apply: they must appoint a resident legal representative, file a notarized power of attorney, provide a certificate of good standing from the foreign jurisdiction, and declare the commencement of taxable activities in Panama. Upon approval, the DGI issues a permanent 10-digit RUC number which serves for income tax, ITBMS, and social security registry payments.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. A Panama S.A. is a distinct juridical person subject to entity-level taxation exclusively on Panamanian-source income. No check-the-box or pass-through election exists under domestic law; a Panama corporation cannot be disregarded for Panamanian tax purposes. The only administrative election available is consolidated income-tax filing for a corporate group of directly or indirectly owned Panama corporations with DGI authorization; hybrid-mismatch or entity-classification elections are not contemplated in Panamanian law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) — VAT-like transfer tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary threshold. Any person habitually selling taxable goods or services in Panama is required to register for ITBMS before commencing operations. Non-resident digital service suppliers selling to Panamanian consumers are also required to register as ITBMS taxpayers from the first taxable supply, without a de minimis exemption.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama operates a phased mandatory electronic-invoicing regime known as Facturación Electrónica. All VAT-registered businesses must issue XML invoices through DGI-authorised software, transmit the XML document in near-real-time to the DGI validation platform (PITA / API service), and affix a DGI-generated digital stamp with a validation code and QR code. The invoice is legally cleared only after DGI certifies the code; approved e-invoice issuers may use REST/SOAP APIs or the DGI web portal. Bulk retail invoices require the same validation or an authorised simplified electronic receipt fallback.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Panama are outside the scope of ITBMS or, where treated as a taxable export, are granted a 0% rate. The exporter must prove that legal title passed to a non-resident buyer and that the goods exited Panama through an authorised customs regime. Offshore services (including digital sale-platform operations, logistics and freight) are zero-rated where the service is rendered to a non-resident recipient or consumed entirely abroad. The exporter must present the customs export declaration, evidence of shipment, and proof that the net purchase price was received in the Panamanian financial system within the statutory repatriation deadline in order to claim the zero rate and the corresponding input ITBMS credit or refund.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única de Aduanas – DUA)
Bill of Lading or Flight Waybill evidencing physical departure from Panama
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Ingreso de Divisas) or corresponding SWIFT / bank payment confirmation
Commercial invoice and underlying sales contract issued by the Panama S.A.
Packing list and required nutritional/sanitary certificates for the nutraceutical shipment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI cross-references every zero-rated sale with SIECAA customs exit records, the electronic invoice, the shipping manifest and banking remittance data. A zero-rating assertion is automatically rejected if any of the required export documents is missing or if the foreign currency consideration is not repatriated within 180 days; the full 7% ITBMS is then assessed as if the sale were domestic. Administrative penalties include late-payment surcharges, interest from the due date, and fines for incorrect invoice data; fraudulent export or refund claims are prosecuted as tax evasion with criminal penalties of imprisonment and fines, and all input VAT credits or refunds are retrospectively clawed back together with accrued interest.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No orthodox central bank is constituted in Panama. The Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá serves as the primary banking and financial regulator, while monetary policy is effectively set by the U.S. Federal Reserve under Panama's full-dollarization framework; the Banco Nacional de Panamá operates as a state-owned commercial bank, not a monetary authority.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Panamanian Balboa is a legal-tender currency unit at a fixed 1:1 parity with the U.S. dollar, which is the circulating medium of exchange. There are no exchange-control restrictions, no current-account or capital-account convertibility impediments, and no administrative hurdles on profit, dividend, royalty, or interest remittance to non-resident shareholders. Remittances may be freely completed in U.S. dollars; however, regulated banks must apply current AML/CFT surveillance, client due-diligence standards, and reporting thresholds established by the Financial Analysis Unit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Panama imposes no export-proceeds surrender regime. Exporters may retain 100 percent of export receipts indefinitely in U.S.-dollar accounts, with no mandatory conversion, repatriation timeline, or surrender ratio. All export payments remain subject to standard banking record-keeping and suspicious-transaction reporting obligations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BAC International Bank, Inc., Panamá Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium. Panama has introduced a licensed framework for financial-technology companies under the supervision of the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá. Offshore digital EMI service providers without a Panamanian banking or financial-technology license cannot lawfully take deposits, issue payment accounts, or hold customer funds in Panama. They may be used only as unregulated software or gateway facilitators, with all settlement activity conducted through a licensed local bank. For a high-risk online nutraceuticals merchant, reliance on an offshore EMI is strongly discouraged due to merchant-acquirer and AML de-risking exposure; a fully licensed Panamanian account with a commercial bank or a licensed local fintech is the viable structure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandatory for high-risk trading and e-commerce entities. At least one corporate signatory and the ultimate beneficial owners must appear before a bank compliance officer or before a Panamanian notary to execute powers of attorney and KYC declarations. Remote onboarding is not, in practice, available for a cross-border dietary-supplements merchant; the bank will require the original corporate registry certificate, shareholder register, sworn beneficial-owner declaration, and in-person interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-Risk Merchant Classification from online nutraceutical retail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Product registration or sanitary authorization from the Panamanian Ministry of Health (Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas) or an equivalent foreign regulator; validated business license for the ISIC 4791 scope; manufacturing GMP certificates; laboratory certificates of analysis; ingredient and allergen declarations; supplier contracts; customer-facing terms; and a detailed transaction-volume forecast.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border fund flows routed through high-risk jurisdictions or private-interest foundations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original commercial invoices; international shipment documents; Panama customs declarations and import records; supplier and customer agreements; certified corporate resolutions approving treasury flows; enhanced customer due-diligence forms identifying counterparty controllers; clear source-of-funds statements for each transaction group; and a sworn beneficial-owner declaration matching the bank's register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity of ultimate beneficial ownership or any indication of bearer-share exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified public registry documents showing registered nominative shares and shareholder identity; corporate resolution appointing signatories; sworn beneficial-owner declaration under Panama Law 23 of 2015; passport and proof of residence for every UBO; notarized powers of attorney; and a written statement that no bearer shares or crypto-denominated ownership instruments exist.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound shareholder capital contributions or shareholder loans must be transmitted in U.S. dollars through SWIFT MT103 messages directly to the newly opened Panamanian corporate operating account. There is no statutory Panamanian FX purpose-code classification; banks follow accepted SWIFT narrative conventions and may request an explicit purpose text such as 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION FOR PA_CORP S.A.' or 'SHAREHOLDER LOAN PROCEEDS'. Verification requires the issuing and receiving bank names, full beneficiary account IBAN-equivalent, corporate name, notarized board resolution approving the capital increase or loan, and the account officer's compliance file copy of the MTC101/MT103 cover.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for nutraceutical inventory and logistics are executed through SWIFT MT103 wires for ordinary supplier payments and through irrevocable documentary letters of credit when funding bulk purchase orders or establishing inventory liquidity. The clearing infrastructure consists of the U.S. dollar interbank clearing system in Panama, local ACH same-day clearings, and international SWIFT connections. MT103 messages must include invoice number, item description, purchase-order reference, and the named supplier; commercial L/Cs must comply with UCP 600, be issued by a prime external bank, and be confirmed if the beneficiary is located in a higher-risk jurisdiction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright U.S. dollar deliverable forwards against euro, pound sterling, and Chinese renminbi
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) used to hedge supplier or licensee exposures in Latin American currencies without physical settlement in Panama
Cross-currency swaps and simple interest-rate currency swaps applicable to financing, acquisition, or inventory-credit exposures

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Pago de la Tasa Única) — US$300 yearly corporate maintenance tax
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Ministry of Economy and Finance, via E-Tax portal; payment reconciled with the Registro Público (Public Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the first quarter: January 1 – March 31 (calendar-year entities)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment (after March 31) attracts a fine equal to the unpaid fee (total US$600). Non-payment for two (2) consecutive years exposes the company to ex officio dissolution and cancellation of its corporate registration at the Registro Público (Law 4 of 2009).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Sworn Declaration (Declaración Anual de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGI — E-Tax platform (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by March 31, aligned with the franchise-tax window; updates of ownership changes due within 30 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of US$1,000 – US$10,000 under Law 70 of 2019 and Executive Decree 264 of 2019; non-compliant status blocks issuance of tax clearance certificates (Paz y Salvo) and restricts notarization of corporate documents.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada Anual del Impuesto sobre la Renta, Form 709)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three (3) months after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year companies, by March 31 (a nil return is mandatory even when all sales are foreign-source and outside Panama's territorial tax net)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing/payment triggers a 10% surcharge on the unpaid tax plus default interest (currently ~1% per month); failure to file is also subject to a B/.50 – B/.1,000 fine under the Código Fiscal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Financial Statements (Estados Financieros Dictaminados) filed with the annual income tax return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same deadline as the annual return (March 31 for calendar-year) when the compulsory audit threshold is triggered
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Return is treated as deficient/unfiled where an audit was legally required; penalties for deficiency include fines and recategorized taxpayer status with the DGI, plus interest on any tax reassessed.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit by a Panamanian certified public accountant (Contador Público Autorizado) when gross annual income in the preceding fiscal year reaches or exceeds US$1,000,000; the audited statements must be attached to the annual ISR return. The DGI may also require audited statements for taxpayers placed in special compliance review categories.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Panama (NIIF) — full NIIF for larger or listed entities and NIIF para PYMES (IFRS for SMEs) for qualifying smaller companies; records must be kept in Spanish (or accompanied by Spanish translation) and maintained in balboas (B/.) / US dollars.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The resident agent and the company must file an annual sworn beneficial-owner declaration with the DGI E-Tax portal by March 31, identifying every natural person holding 10% or more of shares, voting rights, or ultimate control (direct and indirect); material changes must be updated within 30 days. The resident agent must keep a complete and current UBO record for the duration of the relationship and for at least five (5) years after termination; false or omitted data is subject to the Law 70 of 2019 fines.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registro de Acciones (share ledger evidencing all issued shares, transfers, and pledges)
Libro de Actas de la Junta Directiva (board resolution minutes)
Libro de Actas de la Asamblea de Accionistas (shareholders' meeting minutes)
Registro de Beneficiario Final (beneficial ownership records retained by the resident agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$250 – US$750 per annum for a licensed resident agent and registered office
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,500 – US$7,500 per annum for a first-time audited e-commerce entity at the US$1M threshold

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday applies to an ordinary Panama S.A. engaged in online retail of supplements. Panama operates a territorial taxation system; foreign-source income is excluded from taxable base. Preferential regimes such as SEM (Multinational Headquarters), Panama Pacifico, City of Knowledge, and Colon Free Zone may reduce effective rates or provide exemptions only where a special license is obtained and the qualifying activity is authorized.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 1221 - Declaracion Jurada Anual de Impuesto Sobre la Renta for juridical persons; mandatory electronic filing through the Direccion General de Ingresos (DGI) E-Tax online platform.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return, plus quarterly advance payments (anticipos) during the fiscal year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after fiscal year-end. For a calendar-year taxpayer (January 1 - December 31), the annual return must be filed no later than March 31 of the following year, unless the DGI officially extends the deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from Panamanian-source commercial activities, including online retail sales of supplements concluded in or fulfilled from Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only Panama-source income. Foreign fulfillment sales supported by shipping records and contracts may fall under territorial exclusion for non-resident shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-taxable foreign-source income recognized as territorial exclusion.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach evidence of foreign place of performance, export documents, warehouse receipts, and bank statements showing foreign settlement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions directly related to Panamanian-source income, including cost of goods sold, storage, freight, payment-processing fees, salaries, and professional services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions require valid invoices and contracts. Payments to non-resident related parties must be supported by transfer pricing documentation where applicable.
Cross-border transactions affecting this line must reflect arm's length substance, especially intercompany purchase of supplements and marketing fees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax determined at 25%, less authorized Panamanian tax credits and withholdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign shareholder-level taxes cannot be credited against the Panama S.A. income tax liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of related-party transactions and identification of ultimate beneficial owners where required by TP and beneficial-ownership regulations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must provide accurate shareholder and beneficial-ownership information; failure causes filing rejection and statutory penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: surcharge of up to 10% of the tax due plus 1% monthly interest, with minimum administrative fines applying to nil returns. False declarations expose the company and responsible officers to fines and criminal prosecution for tax evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividends or profit distributions paid, credited, or made available out of Panamanian-taxed profits; distributions that clearly reduce paid-in equity are not taxable as dividends.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a reduced rate under a Panama DTA, the foreign shareholder must be the beneficial owner, must be a tax resident of the treaty jurisdiction, and must deliver a valid Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC, apostilled or notarized as required) together with a beneficial-ownership statement to the Panama payer before the payment date. The payer must retain the documents and record the treaty provision relied upon in the DGI E-Tax withholding system.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Panama-source withholding rates: 12.5% on royalties and technical assistance fees; 6% on cross-border interest paid to non-resident lenders. Treaty rates after TRC and beneficial-ownership certification commonly range from 5% to 10% for interest and royalties, depending on the applicable DTA.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: A Local File must be prepared where related-party transactions exceed B/.1,000,000 (USD-equivalent) in a fiscal year; a Master File becomes mandatory when the multinational group's consolidated turnover exceeds B/.100,000,000. An informative transfer pricing return is required when related-party transactions exceed B/.250,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama Economic Substance Regulations under Law 254 of 2020 apply to resident juridical entities engaged in relevant activities, including distribution and service centers, financing, leasing, shipping, headquarters, and high-risk IP/intangibles. An e-commerce supplement seller operating through a Panama S.A. must maintain a physical office in Panama, have adequate full-time employees, incur proportionate expenditure, and make key decisions in Panama; otherwise the entity risks classification as a shell and deregistration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately underreporting online supplement sales by routing payments through foreign merchant accounts, cryptocurrency, or nominee persons; failing to file Form 1221; using inflated costs to eliminate Panamanian taxable profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine equal to approximately 100% of the omitted tax, plus 3% monthly interest and default surcharges; criminal conviction for tax evasion carries imprisonment and disqualification from serving as a corporate officer.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorize diversion of sales or false returns may be jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax and fines; authorities may pierce the corporate veil, attach personal assets, impose travel bans, and seize passports.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: S.A. has no physical office, no employees, no board meetings in Panama, and no genuine economic activity; failure to file annual ESR reports; use of a Panama mailbox office without operational substance to shelter cross-border e-commerce income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines of B/.1,000 to B/.10,000 per fiscal year, forced deregistration from the Mercantile Registry, disqualification of the resident agent, and loss of good standing for banking, licensing, and tax purposes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and resident agents who knowingly operate a shell face personal fines, loss of professional license, and criminal money-laundering exposure where the structure is used to conceal assets or evade tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling dietary supplements without Panama Ministry of Health (MINSA) sanitary registration or import authorization; processing proceeds through high-risk merchant accounts without an AML compliance program; using third-party payment rails or crypto to obscure beneficial owners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Seizure and destruction of non-compliant supplements, license revocation, administrative fines up to B/.1,000,000 under AML Law 23 of 2015, and criminal money laundering penalties of 2 to 10 years imprisonment plus forfeiture of accounts and inventory.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers may be prosecuted individually for knowingly processing proceeds of unlicensed health products; personal bank accounts may be frozen, and travel restrictions or extradition requests may apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying inflated prices to a foreign related-party supplement manufacturer or procurement company to shift profit outside Panama; failure to prepare and file Local File/Master File within the statutory deadline; submitting benchmarks without economic comparability analysis.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI transfer-pricing recharacterization and upward adjustment to taxable income; monetary penalty of 2% to 10% of the improperly valued transaction plus monthly interest; public registration of defaulting taxpayers; criminal liability for submission of false transfer pricing documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false TP declarations are personally liable for the tax adjustment to the extent the contrived value constitutes a disguised dividend; travel bans and up to 5 years disqualification from managing Panamanian companies may be imposed.
